'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Brian Fred DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Sandwich.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' retwin310
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
